metadata.description: Short lowercase organization prefix, 2-12 letters/digits/hyphens; start with a letter. Keep stable on redeployment.
Human-readable organization name for the intermediate root management group.
Azure region for resource groups and networks. The portal deployment location independently stores deployment metadata.
REQUIRED: existing empty subscription GUID in this tenant for connectivity and shared platform services.
REQUIRED: a DIFFERENT existing empty subscription GUID in this tenant for the production application landing zone.
Optional separate management subscription GUID. Blank places management resource groups in the platform subscription.
Optional separate identity subscription GUID. Blank places identity resource groups in the platform subscription.
Optional separate security subscription GUID. Blank places security resource groups in the platform subscription.
Optional DIFFERENT subscription GUID for a nonproduction application landing zone.
Application archetype. Corp denies public IP resources by default; Online supports future public-facing workloads.
Platform hub IPv4 CIDR, /16 to /24. Must not overlap any application VNet; subnets are calculated automatically.
Production application IPv4 CIDR, /16 to /24. Must not overlap hub or other application networks.
Nonproduction application IPv4 CIDR, /16 to /24. Must not overlap hub or other application networks.
Non-secret ownership label placed in the Owner tag.
Cost allocation label placed in the CostCenter tag.
Optional allowed Azure resource regions, including location above. Empty disables the location guardrail; global resources are exempt.
Guardrails audit or deny: allowed regions, classic resources, and Corp public IPs. Compliance initiatives always evaluate with DoNotEnforce.
Assign the Microsoft cloud security benchmark (successor to Azure Security Benchmark).
Assign the CIS Azure Foundations v3.0.0 built-in initiative.
Assign the NIS2 built-in initiative. Assignment is evidence gathering, not certification or legal compliance.
Optional Entra GROUP object ID receiving Contributor at Platform. No tenant roles or groups are created.
Optional Entra GROUP object ID receiving Reader and Security Reader at the intermediate root.
Optional Entra GROUP object ID receiving Contributor on application workload resource groups only.

variables.platformPlacements: [concat(createArray(createObject('subscriptionId', parameters('platformSubscriptionId'), 'managementGroupName', format('{0}-{1}', variables('prefix'), if(variables('sharedPlatform'), 'platform', 'connectivity')))), if(empty(parameters('managementSubscriptionId')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('subscriptionId', parameters('managementSubscriptionId'), 'managementGroupName', format('{0}-management', variables('prefix'))))), if(empty(parameters('identitySubscriptionId')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('subscriptionId', parameters('identitySubscriptionId'), 'managementGroupName', format('{0}-identity', variables('prefix'))))), if(empty(parameters('securitySubscriptionId')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('subscriptionId', parameters('securitySubscriptionId'), 'managementGroupName', format('{0}-security', variables('prefix'))))))]
variables.placements: [concat(variables('platformPlacements'), createArray(createObject('subscriptionId', parameters('applicationSubscriptionId'), 'managementGroupName', format('{0}-{1}', variables('prefix'), parameters('applicationArchetype')))), if(empty(parameters('nonproductionSubscriptionId')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('subscriptionId', parameters('nonproductionSubscriptionId'), 'managementGroupName', format('{0}-{1}', variables('prefix'), parameters('applicationArchetype'))))))]

organizationPrefixIsValid.value: [and(contains('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz', substring(variables('prefix'), 0, 1)), equals(length(filter(range(0, length(variables('prefix'))), lambda('i', not(contains('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-', substring(variables('prefix'), lambdaVariables('i'), 1)))))), 0))]
